title: Coastal Cabana Beach House | KEY.co
description_expanded: The house is perfectly located with access to everything the East end of 30A has to offer but without the traffic. Inlet Beach is gorgeous and only a few blocks away- just a quick trip by golf cart or bicycle. Inlet beach also is one of the few beach access points with parking and restrooms- a huge plus!If you enjoy shopping and dining, Rosemary Beach is maybe a mile away and is loaded with beautiful boutiques and delicious food options. We also found a Premium Outlet mall about 20 minutes away! There is a Publix grocery store about 5 minutes in either direction to stock up on food and snacks.The house itself is a dream. It is impeccably decorated and has all the things you could possibly need,they thought of everything!The guest rooms are all spacious with comfy mattresses. The master bedroom feels like a retreat and takes up the entire 3rd floor. The living room was the perfect spot for our family to watch movies in the evenings and have family game night. We will definitely be back!
